sentences.text: 5. Learned counsels for respondent no. 6/NABH and respondent no. 7/MCD submit that the representation has been received and necessary steps have been taken in furtherance to the said representation.

6. The present petition is disposed of with direction to the concerned respondents to whom the petitioner has made representations, to examine the contention made in the said representations and pass a reasoned order after following due procedure as per law, under intimation to the petitioner herein within a period of 8 weeks from today.
Needless to say that on receipt of order passed by the concerned authorities, if the petitioner has grievances, he will be at liberty to initiate appropriate proceedings in accordance with the law.
7. Copy of the order be sent to all the respondents for necessary information and compliance.

8. Pending application(s), if any, also stands disposed of.
9. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court forthwith.
AMIT SHARMA, J AUGUST 8, 2025/
